summary: OWNER-EV4-REGEN-01 (2026-10-02). EV4's 100 panel predictions were regenerated from EV4's own plan at its code ref on one A40 pod (about USD 0.22, termination verified, ev4-regen campaign with a USD 5 ceiling inside the USD 25 cap). They were content-verified: every member's recomputed exam components equal EV4's recorded ones exactly; byte digests differ only in wall-clock fields. SR-2 and SR-3 reran on 99 members under their frozen rules: NO_PROMOTION for both. The larger panel reverses EV2: the margin legs rank models far better than decision agreement (m 0.388, n 0.366, g 0.262), but no profile beats the deciding rule beyond noise (best 0.420 vs 0.403). The deciding rule's 7 verification divergence conditions are 2 constructed controls, 3 kNN self-orderings and 2 real near-ties, so the pre-registered count cannot show real-model gains. Recommendation to the TRACK-B-STUCK-01 review: keep the deciding rule for ranking, add a separate optimism-near-limits admissibility gate with a science-set threshold, report real-member divergence separately in future studies, and confirm once in EV5.
